QuestInfo.name: Beginner Warrior's Last Training Session
QuestInfo.0: You're really starting to look like a Warrior now. #b#p1022000##k wants to give you a final training session.
QuestInfo.1: #p1022000# wants you to hunt #r15 #o1130100#s#k. #o1130100#s look like #o0130100#s but are much stronger. You should stay on guard at all times.\n\n#o1130100# #r#a21311##k
QuestInfo.2: You wiped out 15 #o1130100#s. Thanks to #p1022000#, you're well on your path of becoming a true Warrior.

0.0: 어린 전사 형제여. 지금까지 수련을 잘 따라와 주었네. 부족하되, 이제는 어느 정도 틀을 갖춘 자네의 모습이 보이는군. 정말 기쁘네. 자신만만한 자네의 눈빛을 보니 지금까지의 수련을 시험해 보아도 되겠군.

yes.0: 다크 스텀프 15마리를 사냥해 보게. 그것은 스텀프와 유사하게 생겼지만 그보다는 훨씬 강한 몬스터이지. 사냥할 때 긴장을 풀어서는 안 될 것이네. 하지만 걱정은 말게. 자네가 지금까지 수련을 열심히 했다면 그리 어렵지 않은 상대일 것이니.

no.0: 시험이 두려운 건가? 두려워하지 말게. 자네는 이미 한 명의 전사이니.

0.0: Young Warrior! You've been trained well. Now, though you need more training, you are ready to become a Warrior. I'm really happy. I can see confidence in your eyes. Let me test you now!

yes.0: Try hunting #r15 #o1130100#s#k. Although they look similar to #o0130100#s, they are much stronger. Do not lower your guard while hunting them. But don't worry, if you have trained diligently, they should not be too difficult.

no.0: Are you afraid of the test? Please don't. You are already a Warrior.

1.0: Young Warrior, you have successfully hunted 15 #o1130100#s. I knew you were capable... Yet, I'm still impressed. I shouldn't call you young anymore, though. You've grown so much and so quickly...

yes.0: You just began to be a Warrior. You have a long way to go. It definitely is hard but I want you to face it and fight. That's what Warriors are meant to be.

mob.0: You haven't hunted #r15 #o1130100#s#k yet. Don't be so impatient. Slowly and surely, you should continue your path to becoming a Warrior.
